concrete_examples.description: In NetHack, the Level Progression System is implemented through experience points gained from defeating monsters and completing quests, which allow the player to level up and enhance their attributes and abilities, thus increasing their power relative to the threats in the dungeon.

In broguece, the level progression system is implemented through an experience point system where players earn experience by defeating enemies and exploring new areas, allowing them to level up and unlock new abilities, which enhances their combat effectiveness and exploration capabilities as they advance through increasingly challenging dungeons.

In 'Crawl', the Level Progression System is implemented through an experience point system where players gain experience by defeating enemies and exploring the dungeon. As players accumulate experience, they level up, which enhances their stats and abilities, creating a sense of power growth and making the challenges posed by the dungeon's monsters feel more manageable over time.

In cataclysm-bn, the Level Progression System is implemented through a combination of experience points gained from defeating monsters, completing quests, and exploring the environment, which allows players to level up and unlock new skills and abilities that enhance their character's capabilities, thus creating a power curve against increasingly challenging threats.

definition: A game mechanic where character power increases through experience points and leveling. This creates a progression curve that rewards exploration and combat, while also gating content and creating power asymmetry between the player and dungeon threats.
exclusion_criteria: Progression through item acquisition only (no XP/level system)
Pure skill-based progression without level structure
inclusion_criteria: Character gains experience points from actions (combat, exploration)
Experience accumulation leads to level increases
Leveling grants tangible power increases (HP, stats, abilities)
Progression curve creates risk/reward decisions about engaging threats
title: Level Progression System
